Reflects the v6.3.1 canon: TICKETS-ONLY scoring (vendors + Reach don't score), the Reach cap on committed Buzz, the Greedy Grab sink, Rave Reviews on the Tours-Completed counter, and the table-wide Scheduled Maintenance event.
title: Travel Agents: Taiwan — Player Aid
subtitle: One action per turn · then trim your Larder to 7

sections.heading: Do ONE action
lines: VISIT (here): flip 3 from this region's market — event fires by scope, keep 2 ingredients.
CONVENIENCE STORE (anywhere): flip 1 from any region — take the ingredient, or the event fires.
TRAVEL: move 1 region (HSR = 北↔南), flip 1 on arrival (event does nothing). Gain +1 Reach.
PROMOTE (here): put 2 Buzz on face-up vendor(s) — public; keep total Buzz ≤ your Reach.
BRIBE A VENDOR: win it (below). Moves the day-clock +1.
LINE UP A TOUR TICKET: take 1 from the row of 3, then refill. Your tickets are your whole score.

sections.heading: Bribe a vendor  (win it — one rule for all)
lines: Be with it + hold 2+ more Buzz than your rival + pay its ingredients minus your region-icon discounts (Buzz never discounts).
It joins your tour as an engine piece + may complete a ticket → clear ALL its Buzz, refill, clock +1. Scores NO points itself.

sections.heading: Reach = your Buzz cap  (not a score)
lines: Your total committed Buzz can never exceed your Reach (start 2). Travel +1, some events ±. Winning a vendor frees its Buzz.
Greedy Grab: keep 1 extra ingredient → -1 Reach (only if it won't drop Reach below your committed Buzz).

sections.heading: Events — the island living its life
lines: ⦿ YOU · ⬢ THIS REGION · ➤ NEXT DOOR (read from the drawn region). Hazards tax or delay — never destroy, never a whole turn.
排班保養 Scheduled Maintenance (island-wide banner): HSR down for everyone one round — Travel the long way round the ring.

sections.heading: Day → Night clock  (+1 each Bribe)
lines: DUSK (5th Bribe, 2p): judge DAY tickets into your piles, flip the day layer → night decks, swap the ticket row. Keep your Larder.
LAST TRAIN (10th, 2p): judge NIGHT tickets, then finish the round + one more. Marks grow with player count.

sections.heading: Rave Reviews & scoring
lines: Tours Completed 2nd → +1 Reach; 4th → 1 ingredient of choice + next Bribe -1 (each agent earns their own).
SCORE = tickets only: + value in your 成團 WIN pile, - floor(value/2) in your 遺珠 LOSE pile. Most = TOP AGENT.
